dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you want to join the Druzhna?

dialogues.speaker: Vilora
dialogues.text: Because of Ves—— Ahem, no, to defend the glory of the Tsaritsa, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Vilora
dialogues.text: You see, the Druzhna is the very pillar of order of our nation. It's what we all look towards for authority and guidance! Haven't you seen the elegant Commander Vesna out and about on inspections?

dialogues.speaker: Vilora
dialogues.text: That close-fitting uniform, the exquisite ribbon, and that very cool sword... Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Vilora
dialogues.text: So, even if I have to—— no, no, there is no "even if" here! For the glory of the Tsaritsa, I must pass the test no matter what!
